import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.model_selection import cross_val_score, train_test_split
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission/", exist_ok=True)

# Load data from correct paths
try:
    train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
    test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")
except FileNotFoundError as e:
    print(f"Error loading data: {e}")
    raise SystemExit(1)

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Drop null values
train_df = train_df.dropna(subset=["Comment", "Insult"])
test_df = test_df.dropna(subset=["Comment"])


# Preprocess comments - convert any unicode escapes and normalize
def preprocess_comment(comment):
    # Remove surrounding quotes if present and handle escapes
    if isinstance(comment, str):
        comment = comment.replace("\\\\", "\\")
        comment = comment.strip('"').strip()
    return comment


train_df["Comment_clean"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_comment)
test_df["Comment_clean"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_comment)

# Get column names from sample submission to ensure format compliance
col_names = list(sample_sub.columns.values)
print(f"Sample submission columns: {col_names}")

# Create pipeline for TF-IDF and prediction
clf = Pipeline(
    [
        (
            "tfidf",
            TfidfVectorizer(
                lowercase=False,
                strip_accents="unicode",
                analyzer="char_wb",
                ngram_range=(1, 2),
                max_features=50000,
                stop_words=None,
            ),
        ),
        (
            "model",
            LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000, solver="lbfgs", random_state=42, C=1.0),
        ),
    ]
)

# Split into train/validation for proper hold-out estimation
# We want to avoid any leakage where test or validation data is used to adjust model weights
X_train_df_full = train_df["Comment_clean"]
y_train_df_full = train_df["Insult"]

# Note: Using stratify to maintain class distribution
X_val, X_train, y_val, y_train = train_test_split(
    X_train_df_full,
    y_train_df_full,
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y_train_df_full,
    shuffle=False,  # Maintain order consistency for potential batch alignment
)

print(f"Training Set Size: {len(X_train)}")
print(f"Validation Set Size: {len(X_val)}")

# Train model on FULL training data (including held-out portion we don't score)
# NOTE: Do NOT refit on combined data (X_train + X_val) to prevent data leakage
clf.fit(X_train, y_train)

# Evaluate on proper hold-out (never trained on)
y_pred_proba_val = clf.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
auc_val = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_pred_proba_val)

# Use cross-validation on the training split as a secondary robustness check (optional but good for reporting)
# Avoiding full CV on the smaller train split to save time, relying on the held-out validation

# auc_valid_final = (auc_val + auc_cv) / 2

print(f"AUC-ROC on hold-out validation set: {auc_val:.4f}")

# Generate predictions for test set
y_pred_proba_test = clf.predict_proba(test_df["Comment_clean"])[:, 1]

# Ensure submission format matches exactly (load sample to confirm mapping)
# Assuming sample_submission_null.csv has the same structure as test_data + id_col
# Map based on finding which columns exist in both
submission_columns_map = {}
for idx, col in enumerate(col_names):
    if col == "Comment":
        submission_columns_map[col] = "Comment"
    elif col == "Date":
        submission_columns_map[col] = "Date"
    elif col in ["Insult", "label", "prediction"]:
        submission_columns_map[col] = col  # Prediction Column Name

# Construct submission dataframe matching sample format

    {
        col_names[0]: test_df["Comment"],
        col_names[1]: test_df["Date"],
        col_names[2]: y_pred_proba_test,
    }
)

# Ensure column order is identical to sample_submission_null.csv
submission_df = submission_df[col_names]

submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("Submission file saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Hold-out Validation AUC-ROC Score: {auc_val:.4f}")
